Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Learn soba noodle-making from start to finish — mixing dough, kneading, stretching, and cutting — then enjoy your freshly made soba noodles with locally grown vegetable tempura as lunch.

【Fee】Adults ¥4,000 | Elementary school children ¥3,000 | Preschool children ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, and lunch)

【Capacity】2 groups (up to 4 people per group)

【Guide】Taira Chestnut Garden staff

【What to bring】Drinks, apron, headscarf, towel, mask

【More information】Taira Chestnut Garden: https://tairakurien.com/

Organized by Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tairakuri-soba/
location: 集合 たいら栗園（西武池袋線「東吾野駅」下車徒歩15分）
summary: Experience traditional soba-making in the countryside — try your hand at making Niwahachi soba!
